_comment: GOLDEN SET MANIFEST — copy to manifest.json and fill in.
One entry per stratum is shown below as a shape reference. The real
corpus repeats each shape N times (counts in README.md).
Only `take_id` and `audio` are required. Every other field unlocks a
metric; a take without them still contributes what it can:
reference_text          -> WER (tier 1). Inline string, or a path
relative to this file (e.g.
"refs/take-01.txt"). A path-shaped value
that does not resolve is an ERROR, not a
fallback to inline text — see corpus.py.
slide_advances + slides -> SLIDE-BUCKET AGREEMENT, the metric that
decides the migration. Without these the
run cannot answer the actual question.
reference_words         -> timestamp ACCURACY (tier 2) instead of
agreement-with-whisper-1 (tier 3). Generate
with:  scripts/asr_eval_run.py --align
language                -> the language SPOKEN in the audio. For an
L2-English take this is "en", NOT the
speaker's mother tongue.
accent_l1               -> the speaker's NATIVE language. Lets the
harness isolate the signature L2 failure:
accented English auto-detected as the
speaker's L1, which returns a wrong-language
transcript and silently drops the English
disfluency primer.
accent / condition      -> per-stratum breakdown.
track                   -> derived automatically; override only if the
derivation is wrong for a given take.
TWO TRACKS, NEVER AVERAGED. l2_english runs WITH the English disfluency
primer; native_non_english runs with it DROPPED (production rule in
openai_service.transcribe_audio). A combined number describes a setup no
take actually ran under, so the runner always reports them apart.
Audio files and reference transcripts are NOT committed — see README.md.
notes: Strata shapes for the willab user base. Replace with real takes.

takes.notes: CONTROL — isolates accent from deck, mic, room, topic.
Largest accent group. Watch for auto-detect flipping en->pl.
uk vs ru confusion is a known ASR failure — accent_l1 catches it.
One stratum, mixed L1s (zh / ja / hi) — keep accent_l1 exact so the mix can be split apart if one sub-group behaves differently.

TRACK 2 — native fluent Polish. Different code path: the English disfluency primer is DROPPED, so only domain vocabulary primes the decode. Same speaker_id as pl-l2-en-01 where possible, which separates 'the model dislikes this voice' from 'the model dislikes this language'.
